title: Per-model regional COGS & margin stress table
summary: Working spreadsheet to map amortized infra, licensing and energy components into per-token (PPK) COGS across model families and regions, plus rapid stress scenarios and prioritized ops recommendations.
assumptions: 1) GPU hour costs pulled from cloud pricebook (reserved/spot blended). 2) Average request shape estimated from production traces (median + 90th). 3) Amortization window = 3 years for infra, 12 months for license. 4) Energy and networking bucket uses standard regional multipliers. 5) Currency normalized to USD.
methodology_notes: Compute Amortized_infra_ppk = (GPU_hour_cost / (tokens_per_second * 3600)) * overhead_factor. License_ppk = license_amort / avg_tokens_per_request. Energy_ppk = region_energy_multiplier * base_energy_per_token. Total_cogs_ppk = sum(amortized, license, energy). Gross_margin_pct = (List_price_ppk - Total_cogs_ppk) / List_price_ppk.
key_findings: - Quantization (4-bit) materially reduces infra amortization: up to ~30% PPK savings on Redwood-7B.
recommended_actions: 1) Route latency-tolerant traffic to quantized variants (auto-routing policy). 2) Introduce a regional soft-floor price for eu-central to preserve margin during spot volatility. 3) Expand prefix cache TTL for conversational workloads with >20% reuse to reduce amortized infra by ~8-12% PPK. 4) Run a 2-week reserved capacity experiment in ap-southeast-1 for 2.7B models to capture price breakpoints.
scenarios_explained: baseline = current fleet mix; spot-tilt = 50/50 reserved/spot blend with preemption overhead; reserved-mix = higher reserved share (80%) pushing GPU_hour_cost up due to regional reserve premiums used for predictable throughput; surge-high-latency = degraded batching efficiency (smaller effective tokens/sec).
stress_tests:
- +30% GPU price shock: worst-case pushes Llama-13B eu-central total_cogs_ppk above $0.02 -> margin drop to sub-40% for current list price.
- Cache TTL halved: amortized infra increases ~9% on chat workloads with 2x session restart rate.
- Quant savings sensitivity: moving from 8-bit to 4-bit reduces Amortized_infra_ppk by ~25-35% depending on throughput profile.
open_questions: 1) Need confirmation of regional electricity multipliers from finance. 2) Should we include network egress as explicit PPK line (material for large-context retrieval workloads)? 3) Evaluate customer elasticity if we introduce region-based soft floors.
ops_playbook_snippets:
- If eu-central spot premiums exceed 40% for >72h: trigger reserved-runbook (Ops ticket template in linked artifacts).
- For quant rollout: run A/B on 5% production traffic, monitor per-route hallucination metric and latency SLOs before scaling to 50%.
author_notes: This is an iterative working sheet intended for cross-team review (Eng infra / Optimize / Finance). Numbers are illustrative — treat as inputs for experiments, not final pricing. Please comment inline with observed production metrics or link PRs to update assumptions.
